whenToUse: You prompt first-time users toward their first action.
A search or filter finds nothing and people should change the conditions.
Being empty is good news, as when every task is done.
whenNotToUse: The data is still loading (use a skeleton).
It's empty because of an error and you'd hide the reason.
Several buttons compete to prompt an action.

alternatives.name: Error State
alternatives.reason: An error keeps the content from showing.

alternatives.name: Alert Banner
alternatives.reason: A partial failure where the rest of the content can still be browsed.

accessibility: Illustrations and icons are decorative, so hide them with aria-hidden.
Keep the title and description as plain text so screen readers read them in order.
Offer the main action as a real <button> or <a> so it's keyboard accessible.
